report:
### Sample adequacy
20 fields analysed, 0 empty. 22 white cells counted — fewer than 100, so differential is only indicative. Red cells ~180 (9.0/field), platelets 8 (0.4/field) — counts are indicative.

### Differential (22 WBC)
Neutrophils 31.8% (7), lymphocytes 31.8% (7), monocytes 9.1% (2), eosinophils 4.5% (1), basophils 4.5% (1), immature granulocytes 9.1% (2), erythroblasts 4.5% (1), suspected blasts 4.5% (1).
Outside indicative adult ranges: neutrophils low (40-75%), basophils high (0-2%), immature granulocytes high (0-1%), erythroblasts high (0%), suspected blasts high (0%). With 5 of 8 types outside ranges, pattern is unusual — check slide quality and field selection before using differential.

### Review list
7 cells flagged for review (initial queue 5):
1. **Suspected blast, to review** — cell 6 (field-06.png, conf. 0.71) — uncertain detection kept only because field had no sure white cell: may not be a white cell.
2. Cell 10 (field-10.jpg, lymphocyte conf. 0.99) — uncertain detection, may not be a white cell.
3. Cell 20 (field-18.jpg, ig conf. 0.69) — rare type ig; classifier/second-opinion disagreement.
4. Cell 3 (field-03.jpg, ig conf. 0.95) — rare type ig; classifier/second-opinion disagreement.
5. Cell 9 (field-09.jpg, erythroblast conf. 0.98) — rare type erythroblast.
6. Cell 4 (field-04.jpg, lymphocyte conf. 0.52) — low confidence.
7. Cell 16 (field-14.jpg, monocyte conf. 0.80) — marked for review.

Disagreements do not correct counts; human review required. Second opinion has no blast class.

### Limits
Classifier 97.6% accurate vs second-opinion generalist 65% (weak on ig/erythroblasts); blast class trained on one lab only (97% sensitivity, 3% false positives); red cells undercounted on crowded fields; reference ranges are indicative — lab ranges prevail.

known_limits: The second opinion model is a generalist: 65 % right on single PBC cells, weak on ig and erythroblasts (experiment 01). The classifier is 97.6 % right on the same data (experiment 05).
Red cells are undercounted on crowded fields (experiment 14); the red cell count is indicative.
Reference ranges are indicative adult ranges; the lab's own ranges prevail.
Blast class learnt from one lab only (Munich, experiment 19): 97 % of blasts found there, 3 % of other cells wrongly called blast. A suspected blast is a cell to look at, not a finding.
